authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.observation: EED item 2 maps to DXF group 1002; byte 0 opens and byte 1 closes a control group.

construction: LibreDWG 0.14 generates locally authored R13/R14 controls with nested balanced groups, remapped source graph and one 3D LINE member. LibreDWG JSON readback verifies the values and graph. Generated drawings remain outside the repository.
checks: The source observer matches each physical control byte to the typed brace, bounds nesting to the existing DXF limit, requires closure before another APPID, and requires closure at EED end.

ASan controls exercise nested groups, every source bit and truncation, a source/model-matched reversed brace order, and a matched open/close pair incorrectly split across APPID chunks. Balanced per-APPID chunks pass.

Group, NOD and MLINESTYLE owner profiles pass R14 strict and R13 explicit-partial ASCII/Binary output with mutation refusal, destination preservation and corrected retry. An out-of-profile 1004 binary item retains the prior partial route.
Independent ezdxf 1.4.5 readback recovers nested control groups and a separate GROUP-to-3D-LINE edge in both encodings for each location and source version.
limits: R13 output remains explicit partial; MLINESTYLE source semantics, native cloning and general DWG/DXF support remain unqualified.
This proves balanced transport for the selected profile, not application-specific meanings of nested values or unobserved EED codes.
